name: asio-binder
description: EXPERIMENTAL, UNWIRED native Node addon stub for ASIO (Windows only). Nothing in bridge/, client/ or engine/cpp requires or loads this package; the server's real ASIO access stays through bridge/audify.js (RtAudio) and engine/cpp's own backend_asio.cpp. Read README.md before building or calling it: ASIO drivers are single-client, and this stub does not yet go through bridge/asio-lock.js, so initializeDriver() refuses to run until it is wired in for real.
